title: How to Check Windows Camera Privacy Settings
overview: This draft supports the “Check Windows Camera Privacy Settings” step in the Webcam Not Working workflow. It explains the intended check, safe execution, and the evidence to capture before continuing.
checklist: Save open work and confirm you are working on the intended device.

Navigate to Windows Settings > Privacy & security > Camera. Confirm that 'Camera access' is set to 'On' and 'Let apps access your camera' is also 'On'. Scroll down to 'Allow desktop apps to access your camera' or 'Choose which apps can access your camera' and verify that the specific application you're using (e.g., Zoom, Teams, browser) has camera access enabled.
Record what changed and return to the workflow before making additional changes.
common_indicators: The workflow reached the Check Windows Camera Privacy Settings step.
The observed result will determine which diagnostic step should come next.
